text:
```yaml
name: Smoke Test Mastodon

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - next
      - '*.*-maintenance'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build Fedify test harness
        run: npm run build:harness

      - name: Run Mastodon stack using Docker Compose
        run: docker-compose up --build -d

      - name: Wait for Mastodon to be ready
        run: sleep 60

      - name: Run smoke tests
        run: deno run test/smoke/orchestrator.ts

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          files: test/smoke/results.xml
```
